trust_center.repositoryDescription: Entratus Trust Portal containing FedRAMP Certification Data, security policies, and assessment materials for the Entratus Conversational AI Platform.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Federal agency personnel may request access by visiting https://trust.entratus.ai and submitting an access request with a government email address. Questions may be directed to the Security contact listed in this file.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Secure Configuration Guidance for agency administrators of the Entratus Conversational AI Platform, including recommended settings for identity, access, data retention, and channel integrations.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Guides constituents through eligibility, applications, and enrollment.
Manages high-volume complaint intake and processing.
Handles citizen requests across phone, chat, and SMS.
Purpose-built conversational workflows for specific agency needs.

current.service_desc:
Our cloud-based platform enables organizations to build and deploy intelligent virtual assistants capable of:

- **Multi-Channel Engagement:** Natural language conversations across voice, chat, SMS, email, and digital channels.
- **Multilingual Support:** Advanced natural language processing for diverse constituent populations.
- **Analytics:** Comprehensive reporting on conversations, outcomes, and service levels.

The federal offering runs on dedicated federal infrastructure with a separate authorization boundary from the Entratus commercial platform.

Agencies interested in using this service can request access directly to the CSPs materials through their own trusted repository.
